subject.title: [codex] Confirm Telegram final delivery before completion

question: Should this PR remain blocked until redacted live Telegram or Mantis proof is attached, or should maintainers explicitly accept unit-only evidence for this transport-facing change?
rationale: The code path is source-plausible, but scoped Telegram policy and the real-behavior-proof gate require live proof for user-visible transport behavior unless a maintainer intentionally overrides that standard.

options.title: Require Live Telegram Proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a redacted Telegram Desktop, Mantis, terminal, or log artifact shows the unconfirmed-final fallback/retry path and the intended silent paths.

options.title: Accept Unit-Only Evidence
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept the remaining transport uncertainty and proceed after resolving the dirty branch.

options.title: Pause Behind The Cross-Channel Contract
options.body: If proof or conflict resolution stalls, leave this PR paused while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561 continues to define the broader durable final-delivery contract.

recommendation.title: Require Live Telegram Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until a redacted Telegram Desktop, Mantis, terminal, or log artifact shows the unconfirmed-final fallback/retry path and the intended silent paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership signals on the Telegram dispatch and shared reply delivery paths make this the best available proof-sufficiency routing candidate.
